D.finding: Official derives the same finite-field power-sum moment, the same all-zero-exponent and exactly-one-(p-1)-exponent term split, the same diagonal corrections, the p=3 non-diagonal reverse-edge term, and O(N^3 log p).

E.finding: Official formulates maximum matching via Tutte-Berge, reduces to a constant-state DP, and answers ranges with max-plus matrix products/segment tree. Frozen greedy is both incorrect and asymptotically unsuitable.

B.finding: Official bijects partitions with nested row/column interval chains and computes counts using binomial recurrences in O(N). Frozen exact-cover baseline has a compile defect and exponential architecture.
